title: Air Force takes over Navy UFO investigations

tellings.quote: people were having UFO encounters and the Navy personnel would get really angry because uh Air Force people would come on the Navy ships and throw their weight around and take over the investigations

plain: A historian of UFOs, Richard Dolan, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on an account from a man he names as Donald Kho. In the late 1940s and 1950s, he says, Navy sailors kept having UFO encounters, meaning sightings of unexplained flying objects, and Air Force people would come aboard Navy ships, throw their weight around and take over the investigations, which made the Navy crews angry. If true, it would mean one branch of the military was taking control of the subject early on.
